package generated

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/blueprint-uservices/blueprint/examples/leaf/workflow/leaf"
	"github.com/blueprint-uservices/blueprint/runtime/core/backend"
	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"
	sdktrace "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace/tracetest"
	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace"
)

type App interface {
	Call(context.Context, int) (int, error)
}
type Wire interface {
	Call(context.Context, int, string) (int, string, error)
}
type Collector interface {
	GetTracerProvider(context.Context) (trace.TracerProvider, error)
}
type appFunc func(context.Context, int) (int, error)

func (f appFunc) Call(ctx context.Context, n int) (int, error) { return f(ctx, n) }

type collector struct{ provider trace.TracerProvider }

func (c collector) GetTracerProvider(context.Context) (trace.TracerProvider, error) {
	return c.provider, nil
}

type wrapperVariant struct {
	name   string
	server func(App, Collector) Wire
	client func(Wire, Collector) App
}

// Runtime tests exercise the real SDK policy. Here a provider implementing its
// contract verifies the timing and transport behavior of generated wrappers.
type testProvider struct {
	trace.TracerProvider
	mu      sync.Mutex
	t       *testing.T
	reject  bool
	consume bool
	calls   int
	retCtx  string
	inputs  []string
}

func (p *testProvider) PrepareCheckpoint(span trace.Span) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	p.calls++
	if !span.IsRecording() {
		p.t.Fatal("wrapper ended span before SDK could write __bag.rev")
	}
	var returned string
	s := span.(sdktrace.ReadWriteSpan)
	for _, attr := range s.Attributes() {
		if attr.Key == backend.ReverseTrussInputKey {
			returned = attr.Value.AsString()
		}
	}
	p.inputs = append(p.inputs, returned)
	if s.SpanKind() == trace.SpanKindClient && p.consume {
		s.SetAttributes(attribute.String(backend.ReverseTrussCheckpointKey, returned))
		returned = ""
	}
	if s.SpanKind() == trace.SpanKindServer && p.reject {
		p.retCtx = backend.EncodeCheckpointRetCtx(span.SpanContext().SpanID(), 130, backend.SegPathCheckpoint, []byte{9, 8, 7})
		returned = backend.MergeRetCtx(returned, p.retCtx)
	}
	if returned != "" {
		span.SetAttributes(attribute.String(backend.ReverseBaggageKey, returned))
	}
}
func newProvider(t *testing.T, reject bool) (*testProvider, *tracetest.SpanRecorder) {
	recorder := tracetest.NewSpanRecorder()
	tp := sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(sdktrace.WithSpanProcessor(recorder))
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = tp.Shutdown(context.Background()) })
	return &testProvider{TracerProvider: tp, t: t, reject: reject}, recorder
}

func TestServerReadsSDKCarrierAndMergesChildren(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("REVERSE_TRUSS", "on")
	child := backend.EncodeCheckpointRetCtx(trace.SpanID{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}, 16384, backend.SegStructuralCheckpoint, []byte{6, 5, 4})
	appErr := errors.New("application error")
	for _, variant := range wrapperVariants {
		for _, tc := range []struct {
			name          string
			reject, child bool
		}{
			{"accept", false, false}, {"reject", true, false},
			{"forward_child", false, true}, {"merge_child", true, true},
		} {
			t.Run(variant.name+"/"+tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				provider, recorder := newProvider(t, tc.reject)
				service := appFunc(func(ctx context.Context, n int) (int, error) {
					if tc.child {
						backend.AddToMerge(ctx, child)
					}
					return n + 1, appErr
				})
				server := variant.server(service, collector{provider})
				result, retCtx, err := server.Call(context.Background(), 41, "")
				if result != 42 || err != appErr || provider.calls != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("application/SDK contract: result=%d err=%v calls=%d", result, err, provider.calls)
				}
				want := provider.retCtx
				if tc.child {
					want = backend.MergeRetCtx(child, want)
					if len(provider.inputs) != 1 || provider.inputs[0] != child {
						t.Fatal("server did not attach coalesced child returns before SDK preparation")
					}
				}
				if retCtx != want {
					t.Fatalf("return lost SDK or child payload: got %q want %q", retCtx, want)
				}
				ended := recorder.Ended()
				if len(ended) != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("expected one normal span end, got %d", len(ended))
				}
				if tc.reject {
					cps, err := backend.DecodeReturnedCheckpoints(retCtx)
					if err != nil || len(cps) == 0 {
						t.Fatalf("invalid return: %v", err)
					}
					own := cps[len(cps)-1]
					if own.SpanID != ended[0].SpanContext().SpanID() || own.Depth != 130 {
						t.Fatalf("wrapper changed checkpoint location: %+v", own)
					}
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestClientForwardsOrCheckpointsReturnedLocation(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("REVERSE_TRUSS", "on")
	t.Setenv("RT_POLICY", "1")
	t.Setenv("RT_DEPTH", "1000000")
	for _, variant := range wrapperVariants {
		for _, consume := range []bool{false, true} {
			name := "forward"
			if consume {
				name = "consume"
			}
			t.Run(variant.name+"/"+name, func(t *testing.T) {
				// Deliberately oppose the provider's decision: the wrapper must
				// obey the SDK even when the old wrapper policy would disagree.
				t.Setenv("RT_ROOT", "on")
				if consume {
					t.Setenv("RT_ROOT", "off")
				}
				leafProvider, leafRecorder := newProvider(t, true)
				parentProvider, parentRecorder := newProvider(t, false)
				parentProvider.consume = consume
				leaf := variant.server(appFunc(func(ctx context.Context, n int) (int, error) {
					if backend.GetBaggageFromContext(ctx)["rev"] != "" {
						t.Fatal("reverse carrier entered forward baggage")
					}
					return n + 1, nil
				}), collector{leafProvider})
				client := variant.client(leaf, collector{parentProvider})
				parent := variant.server(client, collector{parentProvider})
				result, retCtx, err := parent.Call(context.Background(), 41, "")
				if result != 42 || err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("call: %d, %v", result, err)
				}
				if len(leafRecorder.Ended()) != 1 || len(parentRecorder.Ended()) != 2 {
					t.Fatal("lost span during reverse transport")
				}
				if parentProvider.calls != 2 || parentProvider.inputs[0] != leafProvider.retCtx {
					t.Fatal("caller did not hand the received trusses to the live client span's SDK")
				}
				if !consume {
					if retCtx != leafProvider.retCtx {
						t.Fatal("forwarding rewrote the original checkpoint")
					}
					if parentProvider.inputs[1] != leafProvider.retCtx {
						t.Fatal("forwarded trusses were not attached to the parent server span")
					}
				} else {
					if retCtx != "" {
						t.Fatal("consumed checkpoint also returned upstream")
					}
					var checkpoint string
					for _, span := range parentRecorder.Ended() {
						for _, attr := range span.Attributes() {
							if attr.Key == backend.ReverseTrussCheckpointKey {
								checkpoint = attr.Value.AsString()
							}
						}
					}
					if checkpoint != leafProvider.retCtx {
						t.Fatal("caller did not checkpoint the SDK payload")
					}
					got, _ := backend.DecodeReturnedCheckpoints(checkpoint)
					want, _ := backend.DecodeReturnedCheckpoints(leafProvider.retCtx)
					if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
						t.Fatal("caller changed original checkpoint locations")
					}
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestUnsampledServerSkipsCheckpointPreparation(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("REVERSE_TRUSS", "on")
	for _, variant := range wrapperVariants {
		t.Run(variant.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			provider, recorder := newProvider(t, true)
			server := variant.server(appFunc(func(ctx context.Context, n int) (int, error) {
				if trace.SpanContextFromContext(ctx).IsSampled() {
					t.Fatal("unsampled context was changed")
				}
				return n + 1, nil
			}), collector{provider})
			result, retCtx, err := server.Call(context.Background(), 41, "U:0102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f100102030405060708")
			if result != 42 || err != nil || retCtx != "" || provider.calls != 0 || len(recorder.Ended()) != 0 {
				t.Fatal("unsampled fast path started checkpointing or changed application result")
			}
		})
	}
}

type treeChild struct{ App }

func (c treeChild) Process(ctx context.Context, n int64) (int64, error) {
	result, err := c.Call(ctx, int(n))
	return int64(result), err
}

type fanoutApp struct{ node leaf.TreeNode }

func (a fanoutApp) Call(ctx context.Context, n int) (int, error) {
	result, err := a.node.Process(ctx, int64(n))
	return int(result), err
}

func TestConcurrentFanoutThroughGeneratedWrappers(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("REVERSE_TRUSS", "on")
	for _, variant := range wrapperVariants {
		t.Run(variant.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			const width = 8
			started := make(chan struct{}, width)
			release := make(chan struct{})
			parentProvider, parentRecorder := newProvider(t, false)
			var children []leaf.TreeNode
			var leafProviders []*testProvider
			for i := 0; i < width; i++ {
				provider, _ := newProvider(t, true)
				leafProviders = append(leafProviders, provider)
				server := variant.server(appFunc(func(ctx context.Context, n int) (int, error) {
					started <- struct{}{}
					select {
					case <-release:
						return n + 1, nil
					case <-ctx.Done():
						return 0, ctx.Err()
					}
				}), collector{provider})
				children = append(children, treeChild{variant.client(server, collector{parentProvider})})
			}
			node, err := leaf.NewFanoutNodeImpl(ctx, "0", children...)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			parent := variant.server(fanoutApp{node}, collector{parentProvider})
			type response struct {
				value  int
				retCtx string
				err    error
			}
			done := make(chan response, 1)
			go func() {
				value, retCtx, err := parent.Call(ctx, 41, "")
				done <- response{value, retCtx, err}
			}()
			for i := 0; i < width; i++ {
				select {
				case <-started:
				case <-ctx.Done():
					t.Fatal("generated child calls did not run concurrently")
				}
			}
			close(release)
			var got response
			select {
			case got = <-done:
			case <-ctx.Done():
				t.Fatal("parent did not finish")
			}
			if got.err != nil || got.value != width*42 {
				t.Fatalf("fanout result: %+v", got)
			}
			checkpoints, err := backend.DecodeReturnedCheckpoints(got.retCtx)
			if err != nil || len(checkpoints) != width {
				t.Fatalf("lost sibling trusses: %+v, %v", checkpoints, err)
			}
			want := make(map[trace.SpanID]backend.ReturnedCheckpoint)
			for _, provider := range leafProviders {
				cps, err := backend.DecodeReturnedCheckpoints(provider.retCtx)
				if err != nil || len(cps) != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("leaf did not originate its truss: %v", err)
				}
				want[cps[0].SpanID] = cps[0]
			}
			for _, checkpoint := range checkpoints {
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(checkpoint, want[checkpoint.SpanID]) {
					t.Fatal("fan-in rewrote or duplicated a sibling checkpoint")
				}
				delete(want, checkpoint.SpanID)
			}
			if len(parentRecorder.Ended()) != width+1 || parentProvider.calls != width+1 {
				t.Fatal("parent returned before all client spans and SDK decisions finished")
			}
			if parentProvider.inputs[width] != got.retCtx {
				t.Fatal("server SDK did not receive the complete fan-in bundle")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestComposedPatternsThroughGeneratedWrappers(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("REVERSE_TRUSS", "on")
	for _, variant := range wrapperVariants {
		t.Run(variant.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			leafProvider, leafRecorder := newProvider(t, true)
			parentProvider, parentRecorder := newProvider(t, false)
			server := variant.server(appFunc(func(_ context.Context, n int) (int, error) {
				return n + 1, nil
			}), collector{leafProvider})
			child := treeChild{variant.client(server, collector{parentProvider})}
			config := `{"dependencies":["child"],"pattern":{"sequence":[{"call":"child"},{"parallel":[{"repeat":{"count":3,"do":{"call":"child"}}},{"call":"child"}]},{"call":"child"}]}}`
			node, err := leaf.NewPatternNodeImpl(context.Background(), config, child)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			parent := variant.server(fanoutApp{node}, collector{parentProvider})
			result, retCtx, err := parent.Call(context.Background(), 7, "")
			if err != nil || result != 48 {
				t.Fatalf("pattern result = %d, %v", result, err)
			}
			checkpoints, err := backend.DecodeReturnedCheckpoints(retCtx)
			if err != nil || len(checkpoints) != 6 || len(leafRecorder.Ended()) != 6 || len(parentRecorder.Ended()) != 7 {
				t.Fatalf("lost calls or checkpoints in composed pattern: %d, %v", len(checkpoints), err)
			}
			origins := make(map[trace.SpanID]bool)
			for _, span := range leafRecorder.Ended() {
				origins[span.SpanContext().SpanID()] = true
			}
			for _, checkpoint := range checkpoints {
				if !origins[checkpoint.SpanID] || checkpoint.Depth != 130 || !reflect.DeepEqual(checkpoint.Truss, []byte{9, 8, 7}) {
					t.Fatalf("pattern changed a returned location/truss: %+v", checkpoint)
				}
				delete(origins, checkpoint.SpanID)
			}
			if len(parentProvider.inputs) != 7 || parentProvider.inputs[6] != retCtx {
				t.Fatal("server SDK did not receive returns from every completed pattern step")
			}
		})
	}
}
